introducing.name: Delta Eridani 4
introducing.description: The fourth inner rocky planet in the [[location:delta-eridani]] system, also called DE-4. It is slightly larger than [[location:earth]], with lower gravity and a somewhat denser atmosphere. Its temperate-to-subtropical landscape mixes meadows, rocky bluffs and forests of huge brownish trees, and its varied wildlife includes six-legged insect and mammal analogues, bird analogues and a colour-changing winged creature [[character:bob-replicant]] calls a hippogriff.
introducing.state: [[character:bob-replicant]] has ruled it out as a colonization target after his concealed drones observed fire-using native inhabitants.

introducing.name: natives
introducing.description: A native population of [[location:delta-eridani-4|Delta Eridani 4]] that [[character:bob-replicant]] judges to be fire-using and probably intelligent. The beings have bat- and pig-like faces, long spiderish limbs, light brownish-gray to orangey-tan fur, patterned heads, and mobile expressive ears. Bob observes six apparently friendly groups, each tending a fire and interacting with the others.

updates.current_state: At [[location:delta-eridani]], establishing mining, communications, and system surveillance before ruling the inhabited fourth planet out as a colonization target.

updates.description: A stellar system centered on an orange star cooler than [[location:sol]] but more than two and a half times as large. [[character:bob-replicant]] chose it for its lack of a binary companion, low ultraviolet emissions, long-lived stellar type, and wide potential habitable zone; [[character:bill]] considered it a likely source of habitable planets. Its survey identifies five inner rocky planets and five outer gas giants separated by an asteroid belt. Two outer giants have rings rivaling [[location:saturn]]'s, and the largest is about six [[location:jupiter]] masses.

A practical drone design for planetary exploration. The football-sized surveillance variant carries cameras, microphones, gripping limbs and small reactors; the meter-long biological-analysis variant has many appendages and mechanical stomachs that analyze local organics in about a day. Both can change color with limited pattern mimicry.

Remote observation and manipulation devices directed through [[technology:guppi-interface|GUPPI]]. They come in varied sizes, coordinate across scales and, once their tasks are defined, need little supervision. They can inspect ship circuitry with gnat-sized units, carry video cameras and pick up vibrations through a wall. Running on reusable scripts, they feed ore to manufacturing systems, assemble and repair ships, and refine battle scrap into rail-gun ammunition; printers can make more of them. They can explore planetary surfaces, but without infrared, flight or camouflage they do it inefficiently.

summary: [[character:bob-replicant]] establishes mining, communications, and system surveillance before surveying the habitable fourth planet. His concealed drones find a rich forest ecosystem and then evidence of fire-using, communicative natives, leading him to rule the planet out for colonization and to prepare a report for [[character:bill]].
